en:
I cannot keep myself from going 
into Kirumi's lab...

That room is just so splendid...
I wish to show it to Sister...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kiyo for a while?

You also have interest in the Victorian era,
do you not, Shuichi?

After all, it is the era of detectives and 
phantom thieves...though only in fiction.

Ah, but there was also that famous serial
killer. Perhaps you've more interest in that?
<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo and I grew a little closer today.
